means: The camera sits under the subject and looks up. Danbooru's standard low-angle tag.
does: Tips the view upward: chin and jaw lead, the head goes against sky or ceiling, and background architecture leans inward over the figure. The subject reads as taller and more powerful without a word of dialogue saying so. This is one of the very few camera tags on this box that lands every single time - both the shot_angle low_angle panel and the shot_cam_angle low panel changed decisively, filling the top of frame with sky and putting the viewer beneath the jaw.
reach_for_it: when a figure has to be monumental - a hero arriving, a villain looming, the moment someone stands up. Also the reliable way to get energy into an action frame.
used_in: the canonical example prompt in craft/ANIME_MODELS.md; shot.cam.angle low; the build sample in studio/make_samples.py; the sprint tag block of films/derby.json
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
